method: candidate lines proposed by corridor detection; identity decided from printed address runs
why_not_one_block_off: Both sheets letter this corridor in its own roadway: 'AVENUE M 1/2' is printed vertically inside the roadway I measured on each (sheet 37 roadway native 2046.4-2252.2, sheet 41 native 2051.1-2262.5, both ~206-212 native px against the '70'' width figure printed beside each avenue, i.e. ~3.02 native px/ft). The decisive address evidence is that this avenue is the 1300/1400 hundred-block boundary on BOTH sheets. Sheet 37: its west face carries the 1300 block of 17TH and 18TH ST (1302 1304 1306 1308 1310 1312 | 1314 1316 1318 1320 1322 1324 at the foot of the block, 1301-1323 at its head), its east face the 1400 block (1402 1404 1406 1408 1410 1412 / 1401-1411); the avenue-face numbers step 1601-1627 then 1701-1727, placing those blocks between 16TH-17TH and 17TH-18TH. Sheet 41: the same corridor has 1301-1323 / 1302-1324 on its west face and 1401-1411 / 1402-1410 on its east face, with avenue-face numbers 1801-1827 then 1901-1921, i.e. the 18TH-19TH and 19TH-20TH blocks. Same avenue, one street band further south - exactly the stacked relationship (sheet 37 spans 15TH-18TH, sheet 41 spans 18TH-21ST). One block WEST is excluded because that avenue is lettered 'AVENUE M' and is the 1200/1300 boundary (1202-1224 west of it, 1302-1324 east of it); I measured it as a control on both sheets at native 1145.0 (sheet 37, crop cand3) and 1153.3 (sheet 41, crop cand2), ~1004 px west. One block EAST is excluded because that avenue is lettered 'AVENUE N', is printed 80' wide rather than 70', and is the 1400/1500 boundary - it appears east of the 1400 block on sheet 37 (crop cand2) and on sheet 41 (crop cand3, sheet 42 beyond it). The chosen corridor is the only one with 13xx on its west face and 14xx on its east face. INTERNAL CHECK: the Ave M -> Ave M 1/2 spacing measured independently on each sheet is 1003.7 px (sheet 37) and 1004.5 px (sheet 41), agreeing to 0.8 px, and the two avenues give the same A-to-B offset (+9.1 px from M 1/2, +8.3 px from M), so the identification is not one block off. NOTE: neither reported coordinate is a detection candidate. All six proposed candidates land inside a block, not on an avenue - sheet 37 x=1859 is mid-block in the 1300 block (between the 1318 and 1320 frontages, through the German M.E. Church lot), x=920 is mid-block in the 1200 block, x=2799 mid-block in the 1400 block; sheet 41 x=1833 is mid-block in the 1300 block (between 1318 and 1320), x=866 mid-block in the 1200 block, x=2801 mid-block in the 1400 block (between 1416 and 1418). The 20 ft dashed alleys labelled 8" W PIPE / 6" W PIPE sit near these, but the values reported here are ruler-read centres of the lettered 70 ft Ave M 1/2 roadway, averaged over five disjoint scan bands per sheet (sd 2.7 px on sheet 37, 1.7 px on sheet 41).
